articles.title: The Kremlin hopes the US election shake-up won't shift Trump's negotiations on Ukraine
articles.description: The Republicans’ defeat in the U.S. midterm elections was watched closely in Russia, where some observers are predicting it could herald more support for Ukraine when the Democrats take over Congress in January. But if the Kremlin is hearing the ticking of a clock on its nearly 5-year-old full-scale invasion of its neighbor, it seemingly remains unperturbed. Many Russian commentators argue that the Democrats’ victory could put congressional pressure on President Donald Trump to tread more carefully and toughen his stand on Russia. But others say that Trump will not be more constrained because he will no longer be looking over his shoulder at upcoming elections.
